title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Terms: Vehicle Change Pricing for Long-Tenure Tenants
content:
**Term.** The swap fee level for a change of vehicle on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is multiplied by 0.5 for a tenant who has held the agreement at least 36 months, and by 0.75 for a tenant who has held it at least 24 months but fewer than 36 months; for every other tenant this term makes no adjustment.

Months held are whole calendar months from the start date to the handling date, counted to the same day of the later month (or that month's last day where the day does not exist). The multiplied amount is not rounded at this point; the fee is rounded to the cent at the end.

| Months held | Multiplier on the swap fee level |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0.5 |
| 24 to 35 | 0.75 |
| under 24 | no adjustment |

Hypothetical figures: a swap fee level of $35.00 becomes $17.50 at 36 months and $26.25 at 24 months; at 23 months this term makes no adjustment.
